questions.question: A company's About page has no category keywords. What does the service do?
options: Return Other with confidence 0.0, which goes to review
questions.explanation: The situation is defined out of existence: it is a normal, weak suggestion, not an error.

questions.question: Why does an impossible confidence raise instead of being sent to review?
options: It can only come from a bug, and continuing would spread bad data.
questions.explanation: Impossible states mean the program is wrong. Crashing early stops the damage and points straight at the cause.

questions.question: Which failure does the service deliberately leave unhandled?
options: A failed save to the store
questions.explanation: Hiding a failed save would silently lose a result, so it is left to report itself to the caller.
